verdict.rationale: GitHub's own materials state that initial pull-request reviews can be assigned to Copilot "for greater speed and quality" [github-docs-9], matching the story's turnaround goal. First-party docs confirm Copilot reviews code and gives feedback with suggested changes that can be applied in a couple of clicks [github-docs-25], and the features overview lists "reviews your changes" [github-docs-56]. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the assignment workflow (e.g., adding Copilot as a reviewer on a PR, automatic review settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality and speed.
